core_claim.P: A user's veTRUST lock reaches its natural expiry (locked.end <= epochTimestampEnd of the expiring epoch, due to week-rounding), and the user does not manually extend the lock.
core_claim.I: Rewards for epoch n should be claimable in epoch n+1, allocated pro rata to users' shares of total bonded balance, including the epoch in which the lock expires while the user was bonded for part or all of it.
core_claim.V: The reward snapshot userBondedBalanceAtEpochEnd at the exact epochTimestampEnd returns zero because _balanceOf decays linearly to zero at lock expiry, so _userEligibleRewardsForEpoch returns 0 and the user can never claim the final epoch's rewards.

distinct_impacts.description: Every lock that reaches its natural expiry loses 100% of rewards for the epoch in which it expires, deterministically.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Guaranteed loss of the final epoch's rewards for every expiring lock. This is not probabilistic, any lock that reaches its locked.end loses 100% of rewards for the epoch in which it expires.

distinct_impacts.description: Users who lock for any duration <= epochLength (including the minimum MINTIME = epochLength = 14 days) can lose up to 100% of total rewards, since the lock can start and expire within the same epoch leaving no epoch with a non-zero end-snapshot.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: users who lock for any duration `<= epochLength` (including the minimum allowed e.g `MINTIME = epochLength = 14 days`) can lose **100% of their rewards**, since the lock can start and expire within the same epoch, leaving no epoch where the end-snapshot captures a non-zero balance.

distinct_impacts.description: The behavior contradicts documented NatSpec design promising rewards allocated pro rata to users' shares of total bonded balance, since a user bonded for an entire epoch receives 0% of their share.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Contradicts documented design - The NatSpec promises rewards "allocated pro rata to users' shares of the total bonded balance." A user bonded for an entire epoch receiving 0% of their share violates this guarantee.

distinct_impacts.description: The only escape is extending the lock, requiring more capital lockup than intended, and the user has no way to know they need to do this.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: No mitigation without cost - the only escape is extending the lock (more capital lockup than intended), and the user has no way to know they need to do this.

distinct_impacts.description: Mechanism: the reward system snapshots userBondedBalanceAtEpochEnd at the exact epochTimestampEnd, and _balanceOf's linearly decaying voting power reaches zero at lock expiry, so the snapshot returns zero for the expiring epoch.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: The reward system snapshots `userBondedBalanceAtEpochEnd` at the exact `epochTimestampEnd` timestamp.
